initial_application: The issue was initially applied by the 2022 ImagingSelection update series: direct commit 5c5a620527e102650cad53df57ff594d1706fe2a and merge 471fbc468b8fd5427fcebad076569e16590ac707/PR #2019 removed the four separate list elements and introduced ImagingSelection.instance.subset with SOP-class-specific alternatives.
additional_context: Later Applied work in FHIR-52900 replaced the generic instance.subset with explicit elements instance.frameNumber, instance.referencedContentItemIdentifier, instance.segmentNumber, instance.regionOfInterest, and instance.waveFormChannel and added isl-10 to make them mutually exclusive. FHIR-53211 subsequently added missing condition links for verification tooling. FHIR-52900 is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was needed.
